name: Goa
summary: A coastal mix of heritage districts, beaches, churches and markets across North and Central Goa.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.description: Baroque church in Old Goa, part of the area's historic church complex.

attractions.name: Sé Cathedral
attractions.description: Large Portuguese-era cathedral in Old Goa.

attractions.name: Fort Aguada
attractions.description: Coastal fort and lighthouse complex overlooking the Arabian Sea.

attractions.name: Fontainhas Heritage Walk
attractions.description: Walk through Panjim's Latin Quarter and its historic streets.

attractions.name: Miramar Beach
attractions.description: Urban beach near the Mandovi river mouth.

attractions.name: Dona Paula Viewpoint
attractions.description: Coastal viewpoint over the meeting of the Mandovi and Zuari rivers.

attractions.name: Shri Mangueshi Temple
attractions.description: Temple complex in Ponda with a distinctive Goan architectural style.

attractions.name: Mapusa Market
attractions.description: Town market for local produce, spices and handicrafts.
